name: ZBP-Credit Card Magnetic Tracks
description: Focuses on track 1 and 2 data, without targeting track 3. As track 3 is less commonly used, and would still be accompanied by track 1 and 2

name: Bank-IBAN (Global)
description: International Bank Account Numbers of any country (GB, CH, AE, SA, SG, BR, ... as well as the EU) written with or without spaces, only when a bank-account phrase is within 500 bytes. EUIBAN_LEAKAGE (Zscaler predefined) covers the EU with checksum validation; this dictionary catches the rest.

name: Bank-SWIFT BIC Code
description: SWIFT / BIC bank identifier codes (8 or 11 characters) within 300 bytes of a SWIFT, BIC or correspondent-banking phrase. The pattern alone would match any 8-letter word, so the phrase anchor is required.

name: Bank-Wire Transfer Instructions
description: Payment-instruction vocabulary: wire, SWIFT MT messages, SEPA, Fedwire, CHIPS, beneficiary and intermediary bank fields. Counted, not matched alone: the engines pair it with an account identifier.

name: Bank-Card Security Data
description: PCI DSS sensitive authentication data and cardholder fields: CVV/CVC, PIN, expiry, track data. Paired with a credit-card match in the engine so a lone card number in a receipt is not enough.

name: Bank-Customer Account Statement
description: Account-statement and customer-record vocabulary. Paired in the engine with an account, card or personal identifier.

name: Bank-KYC and AML
description: Know-your-customer, due-diligence and anti-money-laundering vocabulary: CDD/EDD files, PEP and sanctions screening, SAR/STR filings, beneficial ownership.

name: Bank-Loan and Credit Application
description: Consumer and commercial lending vocabulary: applications, credit bureau reports and scores, income and collateral. Paired in the engine with a personal identifier.

name: Bank-MNPI and Deal Information
description: Material non-public information and deal-team vocabulary: M&A, capital markets, research embargoes, restricted lists.

name: Bank-Confidentiality Markings
description: Classification labels banks stamp on documents. Any single marking is a signal on its own.

name: Bank-Customer PII Context
description: Personal-data field labels found on account-opening forms, KYC files and customer exports. Counted, then paired with a national ID, passport, date of birth or account number.

name: Bank-National ID (UK, Canada, Australia, South Africa)
description: National identifiers of the UK (National Insurance number), Canada (SIN), Australia (TFN) and South Africa (ID number), within 300 bytes of the identifier's name. Check your tenant for Zscaler's predefined dictionaries for these countries and prefer them when licensed.

name: Bank-National ID (India, Singapore, Hong Kong)
description: National identifiers of India (PAN, Aadhaar), Singapore (NRIC/FIN) and Hong Kong (HKID), within 300 bytes of the identifier's name.
